vassar-international-aid-2027.about:
Vassar College in New York's Hudson Valley is a leading liberal arts college. It meets the full demonstrated need of admitted students who apply for aid at the time of admission, including international students (admission is need-aware for them). Students who might need aid later must apply during admission.

Apply ED I, ED II or RD via the Common App or QuestBridge and submit the CSS Profile with required documents; Vassar does not accept the ISFAA.
highlights: Full demonstrated need met
Open curriculum liberal arts college
Apply via Common App or QuestBridge
vassar-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 1 Jan 2027 (RD)
Indicate that you are applying for aid
Complete the CSS Profile and upload documents
Receive aid package with admission
vassar-international-aid-2027.costs: Grants and campus work covering full demonstrated need.

vilnius-university-masters-tuition-fee-w.about:
Vilnius University, Lithuania's oldest and top-ranked university, offers full tuition fee waivers to five non-EU/EEA students applying for master's programmes taught in English or Russian. Applicants simply tick the waiver box in the online application; selection is based on the entrance score and a short motivation interview held online.

It can be combined with applying for the Lithuanian state master's scholarship (which also pays a monthly stipend to citizens of eligible countries such as Georgia).
highlights: Zero tuition for the whole master's
Just tick a box in the application
Combine with the Lithuanian state stipend for eligible countries
vilnius-university-masters-tuition-fee-w.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA citizens (including Georgia and the Gulf states) applying for a full-time master's at Vilnius University taught in English or Russian, with a strong academic record.
how_to_apply: Choose a VU master's programme and apply via apply.vu.lt.
Tick the Tuition Fee Waiver box in the application form.
Submit by the waiver deadline (1 April in 2026).
Attend the virtual interview if shortlisted (May).
vilnius-university-masters-tuition-fee-w.costs: Full tuition fee waiver; living costs not covered.

vilnius-university-masters-tuition-waive.about:
Vilnius University, founded in 1579 and Lithuania's highest-ranked university, offers full tuition fee waivers to the five most talented and motivated international master's applicants from outside the EU/EEA. The waiver covers the whole programme and is available across its English- (and some Russian-) taught master's degrees.

There is no separate application: you apply for your programme through apply.vu.lt and tick the Tuition Fee Waiver box. Selection is based on your entrance score and a short motivation interview.

The waiver can be combined with Lithuanian state scholarships for living costs if you are eligible for those.
highlights: Full tuition waived for the whole master's
No separate scholarship form
Oldest university in the Baltics
vilnius-university-masters-tuition-waive.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA citizens (Georgian and Qatari citizens qualify) applying for a full-time master's degree at Vilnius University with a strong academic record.
how_to_apply: Choose a master's programme at Vilnius University
Apply on apply.vu.lt and tick the Tuition Fee Waiver box
Submit by the waiver deadline (1 April in 2026)
Attend a short motivation interview
vilnius-university-masters-tuition-waive.costs: Covers 100% of tuition; living costs not included.

visegrad-scholarship-program-2027.about:
The International Visegrad Fund (Czechia, Hungary, Poland, Slovakia) funds 1–2 semesters of master's study or post-master's (doctoral/postdoc) research at more than 190 accredited universities and research institutes in the V4 countries, in any discipline and any language.

Citizens of Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia and Ukraine can apply to study in a V4 country; V4 citizens can also apply to go to another V4 country or to these partner countries. Applicants must hold at least a bachelor's degree.

The grant is generous for the region: €3,500 per semester to the scholar plus €2,000 per semester to the host institution, which makes host universities keen to accept Visegrad scholars.
highlights: €3,500 per semester for the student + €2,000 to the host
Any field, any language, 190+ host institutions
Clear published timeline: deadline 15 April 2027
visegrad-scholarship-program-2027.eligibility: Holders of a bachelor's or master's degree who are citizens/residents of a V4 country or of Albania, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Belarus, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Georgia, Kosovo, Moldova, Montenegro, North Macedonia, Serbia or Ukraine; the host country must differ from your country of citizenship/residence.
how_to_apply: Find a host university or institute in Czechia, Hungary, Poland or Slovakia (see the Fund's instructions).
Get a letter of acceptance, or proof that you have applied.
Prepare transcripts for at least the last two semesters (or diploma supplement); post-master's applicants add a research plan.
Submit online via the Fund's application system between 1 Jan and 15 Apr 2027 (12:00 CET).
visegrad-scholarship-program-2027.costs: €3,500 per semester paid to the scholar and €2,000 per semester to the host institution (which normally waives tuition). No separate travel allowance.

vu-amsterdam-fellowship-programme-2027.about:
The VU Fellowship Programme (VUFP) is Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam's own merit scholarship: a tuition fee waiver for excellent students from outside the EU/EEA who pay the higher institutional fee. It can be combined with the €5,000 NL Scholarship towards living costs.

You must be (conditionally) admitted to the first year of a full-time English-taught master's starting September 2027 and have a GPA equivalent to a Dutch 8 (a very high bar; GPA is only one ranking factor). Register for the master's from 1 October 2026, then apply for the VUFP between 1 November 2026 and 1 February 2027.
highlights: Tuition waiver at a top Amsterdam university
Stackable with the €5,000 NL Scholarship
Any English-taught master's
vu-amsterdam-fellowship-programme-2027.eligibility: Non-EU/EEA nationals (incl. Georgia and Qatar) paying institutional fees, admitted to a full-time English-taught VU master's starting Sept 2027, with GPA equivalent to Dutch 8/10.
how_to_apply: Register for a VU master's in Studielink (from 1 Oct 2026)
Complete your master's application and get (conditional) admission
Submit the VUFP application between 1 Nov 2026 and 1 Feb 2027
Results around mid-March 2027
vu-amsterdam-fellowship-programme-2027.costs: Tuition fee waiver; can be combined with the NL Scholarship (€5,000 one-off).

wageningen-excellence-scholarship-2027.about:
Wageningen University & Research's Excellence Programme attracts excellent international students to its MSc programmes in food, agriculture, environment, nutrition and life sciences. The scholarship is a tuition fee waiver for the full 24 months; winners still pay a first-year invoice of about €16,500 for living allowance, insurance and residence permit.

It is invitation-based: submit a complete application for an eligible on-campus MSc (including English test results and bachelor's diploma) before 1 December 2026. The selection committee informs finalists in March–April 2027, a lottery decides among finalists, and offers go out on 7 April 2027. Only nationals of the listed countries (e.g. Argentina, Brazil, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Japan, Malaysia, Mexico, Singapore, South Korea, Thailand, Turkey, the UK, the USA and others) are eligible.
highlights: 24 months of tuition waived
No separate essay — based on your MSc application
World #1 for agriculture and forestry
wageningen-excellence-scholarship-2027.eligibility: Non-EU/EFTA nationals of the countries listed on the WUR page (Georgia and Qatar are not on the 2027-28 list) unconditionally admitted to an eligible on-campus MSc starting September 2027.
how_to_apply: Check that your nationality is on the eligible list
Submit a complete MSc application with English results and bachelor's diploma before 1 December 2026
Wait for an invitation to the final stage (Mar–Apr 2027)
Accept the offer and pay the remaining first-year invoice by 1 July 2027
wageningen-excellence-scholarship-2027.costs: Tuition waived for 24 months; student pays living costs/insurance/permit (about €16,500 first-year invoice).

wake-forest-merit-scholarships-internati.about:
Wake Forest University in North Carolina does not offer need-based aid to foreign nationals, but international students are eligible for most of its merit scholarships, including several full-cost signature awards: the Nancy Susan Reynolds Scholarship, the Carswell Scholarship, the Gordon Scholarship and the Stamps Scholarship.

There is no separate form: your regular application serves as the scholarship application, and signature scholarship finalists are notified by 1 March. Apply Early Decision I (15 Nov 2026) or ED II / Regular Decision (1 Jan 2027). Applicants who do not receive a merit award must show sufficient funding on the Confidential Financial Information form.
highlights: Full-cost signature awards open to internationals
No separate scholarship application
RD deadline 1 Jan 2027
wake-forest-merit-scholarships-internati.eligibility: International first-year applicants (international transfers are not eligible for aid). Signature scholarships are highly selective.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App by 1 Jan 2027 (ED II/RD) or 15 Nov 2026 (ED I)
Write strong essays and supplements: they are used for scholarship review
Submit the Confidential Financial Information for International Applicants form
Finalists for signature scholarships are notified by 1 March
wake-forest-merit-scholarships-internati.costs: Signature awards cover full cost (tuition, fees, room, board); other merit awards cover part of tuition.

waterloo-international-student-entrance-.about:
The University of Waterloo, Canada's leading university for engineering, computer science and mathematics, now gives every international fee-paying student admitted to a full-time first-year degree a CA$10,000 International Student Entrance Scholarship, paid in two instalments. It appears automatically in the applicant portal from mid-April.

It can be combined with faculty awards: Faculty of Mathematics Global Scholarships (up to 10 awards of CA$12,000-40,000, automatic), Faculty of Science International Student Scholarships (up to 15 awards of CA$25,000-80,000, application required) and the Faculty of Mathematics Olympiad Scholarship (up to CA$50,000 for International Olympiad medallists, apply by 5 Mar 2027).
highlights: CA$10,000 automatic entrance award for international students
Faculty awards up to CA$80,000
Olympiad medallist scholarship up to CA$50,000
waterloo-international-student-entrance-.eligibility: International fee-paying students admitted to a full-time first-year degree (excludes Medical Sciences, Social Work, Optometry, Pharmacy, transfer and deferred students). Faculty awards have their own criteria.
how_to_apply: Apply to Waterloo through OUAC (international applicants: by the early-February deadline)
Complete the Admission Information Form
For Science awards, submit the Faculty of Science scholarship application
Olympiad medallists apply for the Math Olympiad Scholarship by 5 Mar 2027
waterloo-international-student-entrance-.costs: CA$10,000 in year one (two CA$5,000 instalments) plus any faculty award; international tuition is roughly CA$65,000+ a year.

webster-vienna-new-student-scholarship-b.about:
Webster Vienna Private University, the Austrian campus of the US-based Webster University, offers English-taught bachelor's degrees in Business Administration, International Relations, Psychology and Strategic Communication with dual Austrian/US accreditation.

Its New Student Scholarships come in three levels per academic year: Distinction €12,000 (GPA 3.5+, C1 English, significant need, excellent essay and references), Merit €7,000 (GPA 3.0+, B2, significant need) and Honors €4,000 (GPA 3.0+, B2, need). They are partial awards; the remaining tuition must be paid. Open to all nationalities.
highlights: Up to €12,000 per year
Three levels: €4k / €7k / €12k
Apply 1 Mar – 31 May 2027 for Fall
webster-vienna-new-student-scholarship-b.eligibility: Newly accepted undergraduates (Fall or Spring) with GPA 3.0+ (3.5+ for Distinction), B2–C1 English, financial need, essay and recommendations.
how_to_apply: Apply and get admitted to a Webster Vienna bachelor's programme.
Submit the scholarship application with essay, recommendations and financial information between 1 March and 31 May 2027.
Receive the award decision for the Fall semester.
webster-vienna-new-student-scholarship-b.costs: €12,000, €7,000 or €4,000 per academic year (partial; remaining tuition payable).

wesleyan-international-aid-2027.about:
Wesleyan University in Connecticut meets 100% of demonstrated need for admitted international students. International applicants may file either the CSS Profile or the International Student Financial Aid Application (ISFAA). Admission is need-aware for international aid applicants.

This is separate from Wesleyan's Freeman Asian Scholars Program (for students from 11 Asian countries); students from anywhere can apply for need-based aid. Last cycle's aid deadlines were 15 Nov (ED I), 1 Jan (ED II) and 15 Jan (RD).
highlights: 100% of demonstrated need met
CSS Profile or ISFAA accepted
Open to all nationalities
wesleyan-international-aid-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-year students who request aid in their admission application (aid cannot be requested later).
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (RD deadline early January)
Request aid on the application
Submit the CSS Profile or ISFAA by 15 Jan 2027
Receive aid with admission decision
wesleyan-international-aid-2027.costs: Grants and campus work meeting full demonstrated need.

whitman-international-aid-merit-2027.about:
Whitman College is a liberal arts college in Washington State. It promises to meet 100% of demonstrated need for international students it admits, assessed through the free Whitman International Student Financial Aid Application (WISFAA) submitted after your Common App. It is very candid that admission is highly need-aware: fewer than 2% of applicants needing full support with no other funding are admitted.

International students without need can receive merit scholarships automatically, and talent scholarships in fine arts, debate, music, outdoor recreation, theatre and dance open after you apply. International students may work on campus up to 15 hours a week.
highlights: 100% of demonstrated need met
Free WISFAA instead of the CSS Profile
Merit and talent scholarships (debate, arts, outdoors)
whitman-international-aid-merit-2027.eligibility: International citizens applying as first-years. Highly need-aware for those requesting full aid.
how_to_apply: Apply via Common App (RD typically 15 Jan 2027)
Complete the WISFAA after submitting your application
Apply for talent scholarships (debate, music, art, theatre, outdoors) by their deadlines
Merit is considered automatically
whitman-international-aid-merit-2027.costs: Need-based aid up to full cost; merit and talent awards vary.

york-international-masters-achievement-s.about:
The University of York, a Russell Group university, offers International Masters Achievement Scholarships worth up to £10,000 for the first year of study to international (including EU) students starting a postgraduate taught master's in 2027/28. Awards recognise academic achievement and are available across departments.

The scholarship is listed as open on York's international PGT funding page. Apply for your course first; the scholarship is assessed on your academic record. York also runs a separate International Masters Scholarship of £5,000–£8,000 for selected countries.
highlights: Up to £10,000 tuition reduction
Any taught master's
Russell Group university
york-international-masters-achievement-s.eligibility: International (including EU) fee-paying students with an offer for a 2027/28 taught master's at York and a strong academic record. Open to all nationalities.
how_to_apply: Apply for a taught master's at York
Follow the scholarship link on the York international funding page
Submit the scholarship application after receiving your offer

york-international-masters-scholarship-2.about:
The University of York's International Masters Scholarship offers £5,000 to £8,000 for each year of study to international postgraduate students from a list of eligible countries, including Canada, India, Nigeria, the United Arab Emirates, the USA, Austria, Belgium and others listed on the eligibility page.

It is listed as open for 2027/28. Apply for your taught master's first, then follow the scholarship link on York's international funding page. It is separate from York's International Masters Achievement Scholarship (up to £10,000, open to all nationalities).
highlights: £5,000–£8,000 per year of study
Covers multi-year master's too
Open now for 2027/28
york-international-masters-scholarship-2.eligibility: International fee-paying master's applicants from the eligible country list (check York's page; UAE is listed, Georgia and Qatar should check the current list).
how_to_apply: Check the eligible country list on York's page
Apply for a taught master's at York
Submit the scholarship application after receiving your offer
york-international-masters-scholarship-2.costs: £5,000–£8,000 tuition reduction per year of study.

york-international-scholarship-of-distin.about:
York University in Toronto automatically considers international students for entrance awards with no application: the York International Scholarship of Distinction (CA$37,500: CA$15,000 in year 1 and CA$7,500 in years 2-4, for 90%+ averages), the York International Merit Award (CA$25,000 for 80-89.9%), the York International Entrance Award (CA$5,000 for 75-79.9%) and the Glendon International Excellence Scholarship (CA$40,000 for top Glendon applicants).

Application-based options include the York Science Scholars Award (CA$10,000 incl. a summer research job; deadline 20 Feb 2027) and the separately listed President's International Scholarship of Excellence. The general International Student Scholarship & Award Application closes 27 Jan 2027.
highlights: Automatic CA$25,000-37,500 for strong averages
Glendon bilingual campus award CA$40,000
Science Scholars Award with summer research job
york-international-scholarship-of-distin.eligibility: International fee-paying students applying from high school (or with fewer than 24 transfer credits).
how_to_apply: Apply to a York undergraduate programme for Fall 2027
Automatic awards are assessed from your final average
For application-based awards, submit the International Student Scholarship & Award Application by 27 Jan 2027
Accept your offer by the deadline and enrol full-time
york-international-scholarship-of-distin.costs: CA$5,000-40,000 over four years against tuition of roughly CA$35,000-40,000 a year.

york-international-undergraduate-achieve.about:
The University of York (Russell Group) celebrates its best international undergraduate applicants with a tuition fee discount of up to £10,000 for the first year of study in 2027/28.

All eligible international (including EU) students holding a conditional or unconditional offer by 1 July 2027 and paying overseas fees are considered automatically, with no nationality restriction. York also runs country-specific awards (e.g. the Global Impact Scholarship for China, India, Malaysia, Nigeria, Thailand, Türkiye and USA).
highlights: Up to £10,000 off first-year fees
Automatic for all international offer holders
Russell Group university
york-international-undergraduate-achieve.eligibility: International (incl. EU) overseas-fee students with an offer to study at York by 1 July 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply for your course through UCAS (equal-consideration deadline 13 January 2027 for most courses; many accept international applications until 30 June 2027).
Hold a conditional or unconditional offer by 1 July 2027.
You are considered automatically once awarding starts.
york-international-undergraduate-achieve.costs: Up to £10,000 discount on first-year tuition.

42-amman-tuition-free-coding-school.about:
42 Amman is the Amman campus of 42, the network of tuition-free computer-science schools founded in Paris in 2013 with more than 50 campuses in over 30 countries. There are no teachers, lectures or fees: students learn by building projects and reviewing each other's code, and the campus is usually open 24/7.

Anyone aged 18 or over can apply, with no diploma or previous coding experience required. You register online, take a short logic/aptitude test, attend an introduction session and then a full-time, on-site four-week 'Piscine' (selection bootcamp in C and shell). Piscine sessions are scheduled several times a year; the campus site lists upcoming dates after you register. Those who succeed join the core curriculum (about 12-18 months) and can then specialise (AI, cybersecurity, graphics, etc.), with internships along the way.

Teaching is in English and Arabic. Tuition is free; students cover their own housing and living costs and, for non-residents, visa requirements.
highlights: 100% tuition-free, peer-to-peer, project-based learning
No diploma or coding experience needed; 18+
Part of the global 42 Network (50+ campuses)
42-amman-tuition-free-coding-school.eligibility: Anyone aged 18 or over, any nationality, no diploma or prior coding required. Non-residents need the right to stay in Jordan for the Piscine and studies. Working language: English and Arabic.
how_to_apply: Create an account on the campus website and take the online logic test.
Book an introduction/check-in meeting.
Choose and attend a four-week on-site Piscine.
If selected, start the core curriculum.
42-amman-tuition-free-coding-school.costs: Tuition-free. Housing, food, travel and visa costs are the student's own.

academic-worldquest-2027.about:
Teams of four students prepare from an annual study guide covering topics such as global health, diplomacy, regional affairs and economics, then compete at a contest hosted by their local World Affairs Council. Each council's winning team goes to the national competition in Washington, D.C., which includes a 'DC Experience' of briefings and visits with about 250 peers.

It is one of the few US competitions focused squarely on international relations and foreign policy.
highlights: Focused on international affairs
Annual study guide provided
National final in Washington, D.C.
academic-worldquest-2027.eligibility: US high-school teams of four in areas served by a participating World Affairs Council.
how_to_apply: Find your local World Affairs Council
Form a team of four with a teacher
Register when team registration opens (Jan 2027)
Study the 2027 guide and compete locally
academic-worldquest-2027.costs: Local fees vary; national travel often supported by councils.
